policy.meaning_of_open: Declared license permits reuse, modification, and redistribution, including commercial use, subject to license obligations.
policy.readiness_note: Lucide and the ten sources added on 11 October are qualified for explicitly bounded acquisition. HTTP source revisions pin frozen subset manifests, observed byte ranges, decoded samples and archived publisher notices. Full corpora, full archive/shard checksums and training recipes are not qualified.
policy.qualification_note: A source is qualified only when an implemented connector has fetched upstream bytes at a pinned immutable revision, verified per-record digests and archived the license notice at that revision. License eligibility alone never enables acquisition.
policy.budget_quantity_note: Dataset Bank acquisition budgets are reserved in the policy unit and settled with the number of verified upstream records transferred.
